Projects

  • Round LED Flash — Annular Camera Ring Strobe — An 84 mm circular annular LED camera strobe with 4.8 V / 2.5 F balanced supercapacitor storage, 21 V synchronous boost, dual 200 mA current sinks, hardware timing interlocks, and ESP32-C3 BLE.
  • Guarded pH Acquisition Module — A 50 × 35 mm guarded pH analog front end with a 16-bit ADC, precision reference and ESP32-S3 bring-up firmware. CAD reviewed; physical validation pending.
  • ESP32-C6 E-Paper Calendar Carrier — A 60 × 50 mm two-layer carrier for a socketed XIAO ESP32C6 and a bare 7.5-inch e-paper panel, with custom bias circuitry, firmware, and documented design verification. Prototype hardware testing pending.
  • ESP32 Multifunction Media & Audio Carrier — A 100 × 85 mm two-layer carrier board integrating an ESP32-WROOM-32E with a 7–24 V DC buck regulator, 3.2 W Class-D I2S audio amp, WS2812 level shifter, and SPI TFT display header.
  • ESP32-C6 BLE Coin-Cell Sensor Node — Ultra-compact 31.5 mm circular 4-layer IoT sensor pod with ESP32-C6, buck-boost PMIC, precision I2C multi-sensor suite, and CR2450 coin-cell power.
  • ESP32-S3 Smart Bookmark & Voice Recorder — Ultra-thin 4-layer bookmark form factor with ESP32-S3 BLE, Knowles MEMS microphone, 16 MB SPI flash audio logging, USB-C LiPo charging, and pogo-pin test matrix.
  • 16-Bit 100 kSps Precision Strain Gauge AFE Module — Precision 4-layer analog front-end stackable module for M5Stack Core2 with low-noise instrumentation amp, 16-bit SAR ADC, Kelvin bridge excitation, and heavy-duty screw terminal.
  • Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W Flight Computer HAT — Pi Zero–sized interface HAT for a high-altitude balloon flight computer: ideal-diode 5 V input, switched camera power, six Qwiic I2C ports, GNSS UART/PPS, SPI camera and a HAT ID EEPROM, designed for JLCPCB assembly.
  • LM5116 Evaluation DC‑DC Board — Compact evaluation board based on the LM5116 synchronous buck controller — wide input range, precision current sensing, and test points for power-system development.
  • TPS61032 Boost Evaluation Board — Compact boost converter evaluation board based on the TI TPS61032 family — low-voltage input, adjustable output, and test points for bench evaluation.
  • STM32 Dev Board — Compact BluePill-compatible STM32 dev board optimized for sensor-focused, low-power projects — flexible power rails, and standard debug/serial interfaces.
  • TPS5431 DC‑DC Evaluation Board — Compact synchronous buck evaluation board based on the TI TPS5431 family — designed for reliable step-down power delivery and bench validation.
  • ESP32‑WROOM Custom Board — Compact custom development board using an ESP32‑WROOM module with USB power, USB‑to‑serial, reset/boot buttons and plated headers for easy prototyping.
  • Senior Design Project - Autonomous Trash Picking Robot (ATPR) — Autonomous mobile robot that navigates with LiDAR, detects bottles and oranges with computer vision, and collects/sorts waste into onboard bins.
  • AI Youtube Video Summarizer — Tool that summarizes YouTube videos using AI — transcript extraction, summarization and short highlights for faster consumption.
  • AI Color Palette Generator — Generate color palettes using AI suggestions — useful for quick UI theming and design exploration.
  • LinkedIn Web Scraper — A JavaScript-based web scraper for extracting LinkedIn data for research and lead generation (use responsibly, comply with LinkedIn terms).
  • Happy Paws (React Native App) — A React Native application focused on pet care features — built for cross-platform mobile use.
  • Personal Living Alert (Marketing Site) — Marketing website for Personal Living Alert — front end implementation and content-focused layout.
